@@ -47,6 +47,7 @@ RUN apk add -U --no-cache autoconf \
   libressl-dev \
   librsvg \
   libtool \
+  libwebp \
   libwebp-dev \
   libxml2-dev \
   libxpm \
@@ -63,13 +64,16 @@ RUN apk add -U --no-cache autoconf \
   samba-client \
   zlib-dev \
   tzdata \
-  && pecl install APCu-${APCU_PECL_VERSION} \
-  && pecl install imagick-${IMAGICK_PECL_VERSION} \
-  && pecl install mailparse-${MAILPARSE_PECL_VERSION} \
-  && pecl install memcached-${MEMCACHED_PECL_VERSION} \
-  && pecl install redis-${REDIS_PECL_VERSION} \
-  && docker-php-ext-enable apcu imagick memcached mailparse redis \
-  && pecl clear-cache \
+  && docker-php-source extract \
+  # PECL extensions from their GitHub tags (pecl.php.net is not reliable enough for builds)
+  && mkdir -p /usr/src/php/ext/apcu /usr/src/php/ext/imagick /usr/src/php/ext/mailparse /usr/src/php/ext/memcached /usr/src/php/ext/redis \
+  && curl -fsSL https://github.com/krakjoe/apcu/archive/refs/tags/v${APCU_PECL_VERSION}.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/src/php/ext/apcu \
+  && curl -fsSL https://github.com/Imagick/imagick/archive/refs/tags/${IMAGICK_PECL_VERSION}.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/src/php/ext/imagick \
+  && sed -i "s/@PACKAGE_VERSION@/${IMAGICK_PECL_VERSION}/" /usr/src/php/ext/imagick/php_imagick.h \
+  && curl -fsSL https://github.com/php/pecl-mail-mailparse/archive/refs/tags/v${MAILPARSE_PECL_VERSION}.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/src/php/ext/mailparse \
+  && curl -fsSL https://github.com/php-memcached-dev/php-memcached/archive/refs/tags/v${MEMCACHED_PECL_VERSION}.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/src/php/ext/memcached \
+  && curl -fsSL https://github.com/phpredis/phpredis/archive/refs/tags/${REDIS_PECL_VERSION}.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/src/php/ext/redis \
+  && docker-php-ext-install -j 4 apcu imagick mailparse memcached redis \
   && docker-php-ext-configure intl \
   && docker-php-ext-configure exif \
   && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype=/usr/include/ \  
@@ -83,6 +87,7 @@ RUN apk add -U --no-cache autoconf \
   && curl --silent --show-error https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --version=${COMPOSER_VERSION} \
   && mv composer.phar /usr/local/bin/composer \
   && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/composer \
+  && docker-php-source delete \
   && apk del --purge autoconf \
     aspell-dev \
     cyrus-sasl-dev \

data.name: 🎃🐮 Mooctober 2026 | Security Update: PHP 8.2.35, SOGo 5.12.12 & Nginx 1.30.6
data.body:
## What's Changed

### Security
* [PHP] Update base to Alpine 3.24, build PECL extensions from GitHub by @FreddleSpl0it in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7534
* [SOGo] Update to 5.12.12 by @FreddleSpl0it in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7536
* [Nginx] Update to 1.30.6 by @FreddleSpl0it in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7535

### Features
* Feat/update UI by @FreddleSpl0it in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7520

### Translations
* Translations update from Weblate by @milkmaker in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7525
* Translations update from Weblate by @milkmaker in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7527


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/compare/2026-09a...2026-10
